description: Provenance manifest for curated source files under pipeline/sources/. These files are not ingested by the pipeline (ingest.py reads only the named entity files); they document the origin of data used by the figure system and record what still needs curation.

sources.purpose: Figure C3 (gwas-ancestry-imbalance): share of GWAS participants by ancestry group.
sources.license: GWAS Catalog data is distributed by EMBL-EBI under open terms; the 2023 snapshot is quoted from the Cell Genomics 2024 diversity-gap review (citation, not redistribution).
sources.status: PARTIAL. Figure C3 is NOT shipped.
sources.blocker: The figure needs a matched world/global population share by the SAME ancestry categories (the Morales et al. 2018 framework the GWAS Diversity Monitor uses). Neither the GWAS Diversity Monitor nor the Cell Genomics 2024 review publishes matched world-population percentages; the review explicitly notes the absence of a standardized global baseline. Do not attach a differently-defined population source (for example UN residents-in-Europe, ~10%) to the GWAS ancestry share, because the two bars would then measure different things. To unblock: curate a same-framework world-population-by-ancestry table from a single citable source with an as-of date, add it here, then build the two-bar figure.

sources.purpose: Figure C4 (food-access-t2d): tract-level food access vs diagnosed-diabetes prevalence across Loudoun County census tracts.
sources.status: SPEC ONLY. Figure C4 is NOT shipped.
sources.blocker: The community dataset holds only a single county-level food-access summary (low_access_pct = 4.5). The scatter needs one row per census tract pairing a food-access measure with a diabetes-prevalence measure. That paired table does not exist and must be curated per the README before the figure can be built. No values were synthesized.

sources.purpose: County boundary geometry for the /community/[region] map (Branch B, county-level rendering).
sources.license: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb / TIGER-Line — public domain (U.S. Government work, not copyrighted).
sources.description: One real county polygon per region, keyed by fips_code (GEOID). Fetched via pipeline/fetch_geo.py and committed to the repo; the static site build does not fetch. This replaced a prior hand-drawn Fairfax outline and added the previously missing Loudoun boundary.

sources.purpose: A true sub-county choropleth on /community/[region]: per-census-tract exposure values so the single county polygon can be replaced by a graded tract choropleth.
sources.status: BLOCKED. The community map renders at county resolution only.
sources.blocker: The community dataset holds only one county-level scalar per exposure layer (e.g., Loudoun PM2.5 mean = 9.2 µg/m³). A choropleth needs Census TIGER/Line 2023 census-tract geometry for FIPS 51107 (Loudoun) and 51059 (Fairfax) joined to per-tract exposure values (EPA AQS / EJSCREEN for PM2.5 and traffic proximity, USDA Food Access Atlas for food access, CDC PLACES for health burden). That per-tract table does not exist and must be curated before a tract choropleth can be built. No values were synthesized.
